Fresh-context adversarial audit of lane pic-a's work this session in the workspace /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, project MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge.

MY TWO COMMITS (at HEAD): d3245aedee and 2790e89c33. Files:
 * NEW: AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/GaloisDescent/PicEtGaloisCover.lean (4 declarations)
 * EDITED docstrings: AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/GaloisDescent/PicEtGaloisBridge.lean, AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicEtDescentRepresentability.lean
 * AlgebraicJacobian.lean (one import line)

MY HEADLINE CLAIM, which CONTRADICTS two standing in-tree prescriptions and inbox item I-1458, so audit it hardest:
"The morphism-property half of `hcov` is FREE. The board priced an OPEN-IMMERSION half as 'genuinely owed' and prescribed base-changing selfTensorSpecCoproduct along T_k' -> Spec k'. That is not needed: the etale precoverage criterion (Scheme.ofArrows_mem_precoverage_iff) asks for Etale, not IsOpenImmersion, and Etale of a section is free by MorphismProperty.HasOfPostcompProperty @Etale. So hcov reduces to JOINT SURJECTIVITY ON POINTS ALONE (hcov_of_jointlySurjective)."

WHAT I WANT CHECKED, in priority order:

1. IS hcov_of_jointlySurjective's STATEMENT the real hcov? Compare its conclusion CHARACTER-BY-CHARACTER against the `hcov` hypothesis as it appears in projections_agree_of_invariant and exists_unique_descend_picEt_of_invariant (PicEtGaloisBridge.lean) and in the two assembly theorems of PicEtDescentRepresentability.lean. If I weakened or re-spelled the sieve, the whole claim collapses. The two §3 consumer theorems in my file are supposed to be evidence it is the real one -- verify they actually typecheck as compositions and are not restating something else.

2. IS THE HYPOTHESIS NON-TRIVIAL, i.e. did I accidentally make it something that is FALSE or VACUOUS? Specifically: is `∀ x, ∃ γ y, (coverSelfSection T γ).left y = x` perhaps FALSE at a nontrivial Galois level (which would make my theorem true-but-useless-in-the-other-direction), or trivially TRUE for a reason I have not noticed (which would mean hcov is closed and I failed to notice)? Probe this. I explicitly claim only SATISFIABILITY (at Mono, where I-1454 says the consequent is also free), NOT non-vacuity -- check I have not overclaimed past that anywhere in the file or commits.

3. AUDIT MY "route measured link by link" NOTE in PicEtGaloisCover.lean's module docstring (four numbered links + a coverMap IsFinite remark). Each is supposed to be probed-to-exist, NOT built. Verify each named declaration EXISTS and has the shape I claim (#check it, do not grep): AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSpecIso, selfTensorSpecCoproduct, CategoryTheory.FinitaryPreExtensive for Scheme by synthesis, CategoryTheory.FinitaryPreExtensive.isIso_sigmaDesc_fst, Limits.Sigma.reindex, IsFinite.SpecMap_iff, RingHom.finite_algebraMap. If any is misnamed, out of the citing file's import closure, or the wrong shape, that is a defect of the same kind this workspace keeps filing. ALSO: I claim isIso_sigmaDesc_fst binds its index at Type 0 while Gal(k'/k) : Type u and that this is "the only friction in the chain" -- is that accurate, or are there other frictions I did not hit because I never assembled it?

4. IS MY WITHDRAWAL WORDING at the two edited sites CORRECT AND NOT OVERSTATED? I said IsOpenImmersion is "strictly stronger than the site needs" and that the second bullet of hcov_iff_scheme_level's docstring is "withdrawn". Is IsOpenImmersion really strictly stronger here, or did I overstate (a section of an etale separated morphism IS an open immersion, so the two might be equivalent at this site -- in which case "strictly stronger" is wrong and should say something weaker)? Also check I did not delete or contradict anything true at those sites, and that I have not left the file self-contradictory.

5. Anything else: axiom-cleanliness of the 4 declarations against the seam control, whether I re-proved something already in my import closure (check by STATEMENT not name -- this workspace has repeatedly caught that), whether any declaration's binders are unused, whether my file's non-vacuity/satisfiability sentences are each backed by something.

You are read-only on source. Report defects concretely with what you ran. Reproduce before asserting. Do not accept my prose.
